caption: A star schema: one fact table at a declared grain in the middle, joined by surrogate keys to flat dimension tables around it. Every analytic query filters and groups on dimension attributes and aggregates fact measures, and every join is fact-to-dimension on a single key.
alt: The fact_sales table sits in the centre with its grain stated as one row per order line and its measures quantity, unit price and line amount. Four dimension tables surround it: dim_date, dim_customer with slowly changing dimension type 2 versioning, dim_product, and dim_store. Arrows from the fact to each dimension are labelled with the surrogate key used for the join.
